title: Document front matter
description: The parsed form of a markdown document's front matter (ADR-014). The front matter is written by hand as YAML between --- delimiters; this schema describes the result of parsing that YAML, not the YAML text itself (ADR-017). It composes the reduced documentEnvelope, not the full envelope: a markdown file is hand-edited, and createdAt/updatedAt/createdBy copied into it by hand would only rot against git, which already knows both. This schema cannot see whether a relation's target actually exists — a document is indexable only once the indexer (T-022) confirms that too, and it attributes an invalid document to its last editor via git.

purpose.description: Why this document exists, in free text. The spec never defines a closed catalog of purposes, so this schema does not invent one.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the language this document is written in. Must match the project's artifactLanguage; that cross-artifact check is made by the core, not by this schema.

relation.description: A typed link from this document to another artifact.

kind.description: The catalog is closed; widening it is a schema change.
